title: Nonnegativity of product influence
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability distribution $\pi$ on $\Omega$, a nonnegative integer $n$, a real-valued function on $\Omega^n$, and any coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, the influence at coordinate $i$ is nonnegative.
